_about: Freshness alert DEFINITIONS (FIX_PLAN R-03, over the protocol directory). Data only: nothing in the repo applies this file on deploy.
Apply with infra/gcp/apply_money_path_alerts.sh prod|staging (ALERT_EMAIL required for prod); it creates or updates each log metric, then each policy, and never deletes anything.

Every metric filter keys on lines written by utils/money_alerts.py (or the check's own summary line) through the pivota logger, which Cloud Run stores as textPayload; tests/test_money_path_alerts.py and tests/test_freshness_directory_check.py evaluate each filter against lines the real producers emit.
${CHANNEL} is replaced by the apply script with the email notification channel for ALERT_EMAIL (setup_monitoring.sh creates it).

log_metrics.name: freshness_directory_past_limit
log_metrics.description: R-03: a protocol-directory (domain, market) fact is past its clock (card fact 72 h, Tier B 48 h) or missing (FRESHNESS_DIRECTORY_CHECK_ENABLED)

log_metrics.name: freshness_directory_missing
log_metrics.description: R-03: one count per protocol-directory (domain, market) with no fact at all on a clock, per hourly tick (the directory merchants without a fact; input of no policy of its own)
log_metrics.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND textPayload:"money_alert: " AND textPayload:"\"event\":\"freshness_directory_past_limit\"" AND textPayload:"\"status\":\"missing\""

log_metrics.name: freshness_directory_check_heartbeat
log_metrics.description: R-03: one line per completed protocol-directory freshness check tick (heartbeat; input of the went-silent policy)

alert_policies.displayName: prod: directory merchant fact past its limit

documentation.content: The protocol-directory freshness check (FRESHNESS_DIRECTORY_CHECK_ENABLED, hourly) found a merchant (domain, market) the directory can list whose card purchasability fact (buyer vantage, 72 h) or Tier B cart-link verdict (48 h) is past its limit, or that has no purchasability fact at all. Such a merchant drops out of `GET /agent/v1/merchants?scope=protocol` (or never enters it) and its purchases are refused. Each line names the clock, domain, market and status; `freshness_directory_missing` counts the missing ones. Usually a job stopped: check merchant-purchasability-sweep and tierb-cart-link-eligibility, their triggers and images. Standing: stays open while any fact is past. Definitions: infra/gcp/monitoring/money_path_alerts.json (FIX_PLAN R-03).

conditions.displayName: prod: directory merchant fact past its limit

alert_policies.displayName: prod: directory freshness check went silent

documentation.content: The protocol-directory freshness check printed its hourly summary in the last 24 hours and none for 3 hours. A stopped check cannot warn about a stopped job. Check the worker, /__scheduler_health (freshness_directory_check), SCHEDULER_JOB_ALLOWLIST and FRESHNESS_DIRECTORY_CHECK_ENABLED. Definitions: infra/gcp/monitoring/money_path_alerts.json (FIX_PLAN R-03).
